Thread A on X's spec: root by T1, reply by N. With the spec's credit list broken, a person's reply E reaches O through the role and its recipient read fails. observations: cmd/listener's TestListenerFollowsTheInterestRegistryAcrossNATSRestarts fails intermittently on main too, so it is not this PR's. Each run alone on the pod: this head 2 failures in 49 runs (3+15+30, plus one failure in a run that overlapped the multiprocess suite); 2ba3ba48 1 in 18; main's merge base d4cbcfe6 1 in 49 (4+15+30). The error is the same class each time: 'ERROR envoy nats reconnect hook failed … rewatch <session|interest> cache: watch <session registry|role claims> KV bucket: context deadline exceeded' after a NATS restart, which the test treats as a failure. This PR does not change the rewatch hooks; on the reconnect path it adds only connectionChanged(), which closes a channel under c.mu. Not found tracked in Dispatch; sent to the architect as a finding outside this PR.
